stories.title: 2 trapped workers rescued from a hydropower tunnel 9 days after Nepal floods
stories.summary: Officials say rescuers in Nepal have pulled two workers alive from a tunnel Friday during an ongoing operation. The rescues come nine days after the Aug. 26 floods.

stories.title: Russia-China relations continue to grow stronger — Putin
stories.summary: MOSCOW, September 4. Russian President Vladimir Putin said in a greeting to participants, organizers and guests of the 8th Russia-China Energy Business Forum that relations between Russia and China continue to grow stronger. "The comprehensive partnership and strategic cooperation between Russia and China continue to grow stronger," reads the message published on the Kremlin website. The president also noted that energy is traditionally one of the most significant and dynamic areas of economic cooperation between the two countries.

stories.title: New passenger car sales in Russia fall by 6.5% in August to 114,300 — Autostat
stories.summary: MOSCOW, September 4. Sales of new passenger cars in Russia fell 6.5% year on year in August to 114,300 units, the Autostat analytical agency said. "A total of 114,300 new passenger cars were sold in our country in the final month of summer 2026. This is 6.5% less than in August last year, Autostat experts said, citing data from JSC PPK and using the agency's own segmentation," the statement said. The leading brands during the period were Lada (27,000 units), Haval (14,500), Tenet (12,200), Geely (6,600), and Changan (6,000). The top five models were the Lada Granta (10,700 units), Haval Jolion (6,300), Tenet T7 (6,100), Lada Vesta (5,400), and Tenet T4L (4,600). The agency noted that 845,000 new passenger cars were sold in Russia in the first eight months of 2026, up 9.3% from January-August last year.
